card.name: Inside drug names, early syllables
card.fires_on: Responds to a middle piece of a drug name that is repeated from earlier in the text, such as the 'im' in pimozide or 'bes' in irbesartan. Also fires on 'rec' in the patent phrase 'The method as recited in'.

modes.label: Repeated drug name
modes.description: Partway through a drug name that has already appeared in the passage, before the rest of the name is completed.

modes.description: Partway through 'recited' in repeated claim wording.
